description: Ministry of Education - Degree Awarding Institute Order - Bachelor of Education Honours in Social Science, Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology (Guarantee) Limited
reasoning: This gazette notification contains an order made under Section 25A of the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978, which amends the schedule of recognized degree programs. It involves legal/regulatory matters - specifically the modification of statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks governing higher education institutions and degree recognition. While it mentions a minister's name, it does not involve government personnel changes or portfolio assignments, but rather the exercise of statutory powers to amend legal schedules and conditions for degree awarding institutions.
